preview.question: 大卫疲惫的时候，亚比筛怎样救了他？

before.zh: 他替大卫挡住以施比·比拿的攻击，直到那非利士人退出战斗。
before.en: He shielded David from Ishbi-benob’s attacks until the Philistine withdrew from the fight.

after.zh: 他挡住了非利士人的矛。

verses.21:15: Once again the Philistines waged war against Israel, and David and his servants went down and fought against the Philistines. But David became exhausted.
verses.21:16: Then Ishbi-benob, a descendant of Rapha, whose bronze spear weighed three hundred shekels and who was bearing a new sword, resolved to kill David.
verses.21:17: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid, struck the Philistine, and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, “You must never again go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished.”

en.question: How did Abishai rescue David when he was weary?
choices: He killed the Philistine.
He took the Philistine prisoner.
He blocked the Philistine’s spear.
He escorted David off the battlefield.
I can't tell from this passage

verses.21:15: 非利士人再次与以色列交战，大卫和他的臣仆下去迎战非利士人，但大卫疲惫不堪。
verses.21:16: 那时，拉法的后裔伊施比比诺决意杀死大卫。他的铜矛重三百舍客勒，身上还佩着一把新剑。
verses.21:17: 但洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛前来援助大卫，击杀了那非利士人。于是，大卫的部下向他起誓说：“你绝不可再和我们一同出战，免得以色列的灯熄灭。”

preview.question: 为什么要把亚他利雅带到王宫的地界处死？

before.zh: 因为百夫长们担心她的拥护者会从殿里的人群中把她救走。
before.en: Because the commanders feared that her supporters might rescue her from among the crowds at the house of the LORD.

after.zh: 因为亚他利雅要求在王宫被处死。
after.en: Because she had requested that her execution take place at the palace.

verses.11:14: And she looked out and saw the king standing by the pillar, according to the custom. The officers and trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and screamed, “Treason! Treason!”
verses.11:15: And Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of hundreds in charge of the army, “Bring her out between the ranks, and put to the sword anyone who follows her.” For the priest had said, “She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.”
verses.11:16: So they seized Athaliah as she reached the horses’ entrance to the palace grounds, and there she was put to death.

en.question: Why was Athaliah taken to the palace grounds to be killed?
choices: Because Jehoiada the priest had said that she must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.
Because the king had ordered that she be executed at the palace as a warning to the royal household.
Because she had requested that her execution take place at the palace.
Because the custom required that anyone accused of treason be put to death at the entrance to the palace grounds.
I can't tell from this passage

verses.11:14: 她观看，见王照惯例站在柱旁，军官和吹号的人在王身边，那地的众民都欢喜快乐，吹着号。亚他利雅就撕裂衣服，尖叫道：“反了！反了！”
verses.11:15: 耶何耶大祭司吩咐统领军队的众百夫长说：“把她从队列之间带出去，凡跟随她的人，都用刀杀死。”因为祭司曾说：“不可在耶和华的殿里杀她。”
verses.11:16: 于是，当亚他利雅来到通往王宫院落的马匹入口时，他们就拿住她，在那里将她处死。

zh.question: 为什么要把亚他利雅带到王宫的地界处死？
choices: 因为祭司耶何耶大说，不可在耶和华的殿里杀她。
因为王下令在王宫处死她，以此警告王室成员。
因为亚他利雅要求在王宫被处死。
因为按照习俗，凡被控谋反的人都要在王宫入口处处死。
根据这段文字无法判断

findings: Chinese blind reader chose ['A', 'B']: 经文提到祭司耶何耶大说不可在耶和华的殿里杀她（11:15），因此A正确。同时，亚他利雅被带到王宫的地界处死，可能是为了警告王室成员（11:16），因此B也正确。

Translation fidelity: A: The English choice incorrectly states 'must not be put to death in the house of the LORD', while the Chinese says '不可在耶和华的殿里杀她' (must not be killed in the temple of the LORD). The English choice adds 'must' which is not in the Chinese text.
